MEASURED AT THE BUILD SLOT (claude/composite-r4 @ f73bdbf16) BY READING ONLY — no test suite, gate, build, vitest, deno test or npm script was run.

── 4a IS FULLY LANDED IN-REPO; ONLY THE DEPLOY IS OUTSTANDING ────────────────
The whole chain exists and is richer than the roadmap describes. supabase/functions/generate-chronicle/index.ts is 430 lines with a 462-line index.test.ts beside it; index.ts:31 `const CHRONICLE_COST = 2; // credits; pinned to src/config/pricing.js CHRONICLE_CREDIT_COST + spend_credits CASE 'chronicle' by tests/config/pricing.test.js`, with bot guard, JWT auth, payload cap (:42-43), daily capacity 503 (:249), per-user 429 (:268), atomic `spend_credits` RPC (:273), service-role `refund_credits` on failure (:303), and a token-cost line (:323). The pure grounding half is src/domain/worldPulse/chronicle.js (140 lines, `buildChronicleGrounding`, which has since grown siege-coalition and trade-war-commodity naming the roadmap never mentions). The client hook is src/lib/campaignChronicle.js (58 lines), invoking the function at :48. The surface is src/components/map/WizardNewsPanel.jsx:381 `generateChronicle()` and :480 the gold "Chronicle" button titled "Turn this tick's grounded news into a two-credit campaign chronicle". The reader is src/components/map/ChronicleScrollback.jsx (342 lines), which replaced the chronicles[0]-only article. NOTHING IS OWED HERE IN CODE.

── 4d: THE DATA IS FAR RICHER THAN THE RECORD SAYS, AND STILL UNREAD ─────────
The record names two archives; the slot carries SIX on every relationship edge, all bounded, all persisted, in src/domain/worldPulse/relationshipState.js `ensureRelationshipState`: recentIncidents cap 8 (:472, emitted :497), history cap 12 (:473, :498), turningPoints cap 24 (RELATIONSHIP_TURNING_POINT_CAP :198, emitted :499), allianceCalls cap 24 (:203, :500), coalitionSettlements cap 24 (:207, :501), hierarchyResolutions cap 6 (:502). turningPoints/allianceCalls/coalitionSettlements are explicitly the "longer-lived source than the rolling incident/history windows" (:192-197) — literally the alliance's survived-history and the refused-summons record ("a refused summons is a diplomatic fact", :199-201). 24 modules under src/domain/ name recentIncidents (22 in worldPulse, 1 spatial, 1 certification).

ZERO SURFACES READ ANY OF THE SIX. `grep -rln` for recentIncidents | history-archives | turningPoints | allianceCalls | coalitionSettlements | hierarchyResolutions across src/components/, src/domain/display/, src/hooks/ and src/lib/ returns NOTHING for all six. The roadmap's claim holds, and holds four fields wider than it knew.

A HUMAN-READABLE READ MODEL ALREADY EXISTS AND FEEDS ONLY THE AI. src/domain/worldPulse/relationshipMemory.js (604 lines) composes per-edge rows with posture, postureLabel (19 authored labels, :47-65), memoryScore, dailyLifeWeight, asymmetry, flowProfile, `recentMemory`, `reasons` and `practicalEffects` (authored table-facing sentences, :313-337) via `buildRelationshipPostures` (:380). `refreshRelationshipMemory` (:443) STAMPS that blob onto every relationshipState, and it runs every pulse — src/domain/worldPulse/applyWorldPulse.js:1130. Its only consumers are itself, the AI grounding path (src/store/aiSlice.js:116-137 → src/domain/aiGrounding.js:387/:442 → src/lib/ai.js:173), and tests. The prose exists; no human ever sees it.

⛔ THE TRAP IN REUSING IT. `memoryEntry` returns null when `weight <= 0` (relationshipMemory.js:133-137), and weight is zero for undated rows and for anything older than RELATIONSHIP_MEMORY_MAX_LOOKBACK_TICKS = 24 (:15, :114-130). So `recentMemory` is a 24-tick decay window, NOT a chronicle: a surface built on it would silently drop exactly the old alliance history the item asks for, while the durable turningPoints/allianceCalls/coalitionSettlements archives sit unread beside it.

THE PRESENT-TENSE HALF OF 4d IS ALREADY SHIPPED. src/components/map/PerspectiveStandings.jsx (141 lines, read whole; DESK-4) mounts in the Herald's War door (src/components/map/HeraldBody.jsx:236) and renders "The world as X knows it" — an observer picker plus one plain-language line per relation: sieges, coalition march-mates, treaty roles, and a DM-gated believed half. It reads warStatus, warAndRoadNames, treatyDocument and settlementBeliefs. It reads NO relationship state, NO posture, and NO archive. The PRESENT standing has a surface; the HISTORY has none. That is the sharpest statement of what is missing.

THE ONE PLACE A RELATIONSHIP CHANGE REACHES A SCREEN DOES IT ANONYMOUSLY. src/domain/display/chronicleReadModel.js `deltaFirst` (:203-244) collects relationship changes into `{ key, kind }` rows — kind ∈ war-declared | alliance-formed | peace-or-shift | relationship-change (:222-232) — and src/components/map/AdvanceReport.jsx:151-155 renders each as a chip containing ONLY `humanizeToken(r.kind)`. The relationshipKey is discarded and no settlement is named, so a GM reads "war declared" with no parties. ChronicleNode already carries `settlementIds` (chronicleGraph.js:125), so the names are one field away.

THE NPC HALF IS THINNER, EXACTLY AS THE RECORD SAYS. `ensureNpcStates` (src/domain/worldPulse/npcAgency.js:422-560) builds npcStates with no history/trail array at all. The durable NPC record is the ladder's: npcLadderState.js `normalizeContests` (:608), `sortedContests` (:645), `normalizeSeatTransitions` (:717), `normalizeRecord`/`sortedRecord` (:764/:846), plus GRUDGE_KINDS = contest_loss | contest_forestalled | rivalry (:387) and BOND_KINDS = loyalty | gratitude | friendship | respect (:414). Its only reader is the engine (src/domain/worldPulse/treatySuccession.js:247 reads `recordOf(ladder[settlementId]).seatTransitions`). A DM-gated NPC surface DOES exist — src/domain/display/npcInteriorityRead.js renders bonds, grudges and credibility into src/components/new/npcComponents.jsx behind `includeGroundTruth` — but it shows STANDING, never the dated contest/seat trail.

WORDS AND SEAMS THE IMPLEMENTER WILL HIT. `titleForType` (relationshipMemory.js:74-76) humanizes only by replacing underscores, so "coalition_betrayal" becomes "coalition betrayal" — fine for an AI payload, an engine token in front of a reader by this estate's own law; src/domain/display/humanizeEngineTokens.js (255 lines) has NO incident-type bucket. Incidents carry no visibility field, and the 24 writers include covert families (corruptionWeb, espionageGauntlet, informationStatecraft), so a player-facing render would leak DM truth; the estate's two fail-closed idioms are viewerSeesDmSecrets (src/domain/display/viewerSecrets.js:48, used by HeraldRemembrance.jsx) and includeGroundTruth (npcInteriorityRead.js, PerspectiveStandings.jsx:57-59). Finally, relationshipKeyFromEdge (relationshipState.js:363-369) returns `edge.id` when present, so the key is NOT reliably parseable into a settlement pair — names must come from the edge or the graph.
